note:
G1 sensitivity (post hoc, reported beside the pre-registered verdict).

Schema-invalid outputs score as "no flag" in the pre-registered metric, which favours the
system with more invalid outputs on H. Two checks, both on the frozen H set:
- worst case: every invalid output counts as a false alarm, for every system;
- repaired: invalid outputs re-parsed after dropping the parts that broke validation
  (tests without a result, `other` medications without a name, duplicate findings).
Item-level paired bootstrap (the pre-registered grouping has only 3 clusters on H).
